definitions.gloss: time, passage of time, months and days
definitions.explanation: The passing of time, often with a nuance of a considerable period having elapsed. Emphasizes the accumulation of days and months.

examples.japanese: {月日|つきひ}が{経|た}つのは{早|はや}い。
{卒業|そつぎょう}してから{長|なが}い{月日|つきひ}が{流|なが}れた。
examples.english: Many years have passed since graduation.

examples.japanese: {月日|つきひ}の{経過|けいか}とともに{傷|きず}は{癒|い}えた。
examples.english: The wounds healed with the passage of time.

notes:
USAGE: {月日|つきひ} emphasizes the passing of time over an extended period. It has a somewhat literary or reflective nuance.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {月日|つきひ}が{経|た}つ (time passes)
- {月日|つきひ}が{流|なが}れる (time flows by)
- {月日|つきひ}の{経過|けいか} (passage of time)

READING NOTE: Can also be read as がっぴ in compound words like {生年月日|せいねんがっぴ} (date of birth), but {つきひ} when used alone to mean 'passage of time.'

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {時|とき}が{経|た}つ (time passes - general)
- {年月|としつき}/{年月|ねんげつ} (years, passage of time)
